about: A highly motivated Bioinformatics graduate with hands-on experience in computational biology and software development. Proficient in core NGS data analysis, including sequence alignment and differential gene expression, with practical knowledge of tools such as HISAT, Samtools, and IGV. Possesses a strong foundation in bioinformatics algorithms with a strong interest in solving complex biological problems. Eager to contribute to a dynamic team and further develop expertise as a bioinformatician.

experience.desc: Completed hands-on training in molecular biology techniques, including cell lysis and DNA extraction, PCR-based detection of specific DNA sequences, cell culture, and microscopic cell counting.

Developed dedicated Android (Java) applications for Nobaar's customers and company drivers. Led the design and architecture of the application APIs, collaborating with the backend development team on their implementation.

Developed Android (Java) applications for Mibarim, including two applications supporting its ridesharing services and a dedicated app for comparing transportation options across ridesharing platforms.

education.desc: Conducted interdisciplinary research at the intersection of metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, bioinformatics, and machine learning. Developed a computational framework for synthetic microbial community design and explored Graph Neural Networks for metabolic flux prediction by leveraging the topology of genome-scale metabolic networks. Gained hands-on experience with genome-scale metabolic modeling, sequence analysis (HISAT2, FASTA/FASTQ, SAMtools, BCFtools), RNA differential expression analysis, and protein structure analysis. Complemented research with advanced computer science coursework and multiple teaching assistantships, strengthening skills in computational problem-solving, research, and academic collaboration.

Focused on software development with an emphasis on Android application development using Java, including the development of mobile applications and games. Designed user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and developed open-source peer-to-peer messaging software using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), supporting both direct messaging and network-wide broadcasting in a decentralized architecture where each device operated as both a client and a server. Gained practical industry experience through Android developer at two companies, contributing to the design and development of production mobile applications.

research.title: Synthetic auxotrophic community design with maximum growth rate
research.desc: Developed a constrained optimization model, extending SteadyCom, to design auxotrophic microbial communities of any size with maximum growth rate. The model enforced modular robustness by requiring each member to produce a unique metabolite essential for the community's survival. Implementation was ultimately limited by the complexity of a constraint requiring a nested optimization.

research.title: Increase by-product yield using a synthetic community
research.desc: Developed a constrained optimization model, extending SteadyCom, to identify the fittest microbial community capable of maximizing any desired by-product yield. The model incorporated additional constraints to screen across microorganisms and select optimal members. Implementation was ultimately limited by the high computational cost when applied to large metabolic networks.

research.title: Organism flux prediction using Graph neural networks
research.desc: Developed a novel deep learning approach to predict metabolic flux, dramatically reducing computational cost compared to traditional methods. Represented each microorganism as a large disconnected graph composed of several small metabolic networks. Achieved a Root Mean Square Error of 4 against current gold standard data.
